ROG Falchion Ace HFX
ZywOo Edition

The Chosen Keyboard

Styled with confidence, the ROG Falchion Ace HFX ZywOo Edition captures ZywOo's unmistakable sense of design—bold, refined, and built to stand out on any stage. Backed by HFX Magnetic Switches, Rapid Trigger, and 8000 Hz polling, it delivers tournament-grade performance in a compact, precision-crafted form.

MATHIEU 'ZywOo' HERBAUT

2023 & 2025 MAJOR CHAMPION

Widely regarded as one of the greatest Counter-Strike players of all time, ZywOo is known for his ice-cold decision-making, pinpoint aim, and clutch performance under pressure. With multiple HLTV #1 titles, two Major MVPs, and two CS Major championships under his belt, ZywOo's legacy is already cemented - and he's only just getting started.

LITERALLY BORN FOR THE GAME

Fate doesn't just play games — it builds legends. ZywOo was born on the very day CS 1.0 launched: November 9th, 2000.

HIS ACHIEVEMENTS

PLAY LIKE THE CHOSEN ONE

The Falchion Ace HFX ZywOo Edition brings a fresh visual edge with bold color blocking and custom keycap designs. Magenta-tinted WASD keys and yellow accents on the Enter key highlight high-action zones, while the ESC, Tab, Backspace, and Enter keys feature unique legends and icons—including a sniper rifle motif. Signed on the spacebar and styled for dominance, this is the chosen keyboard.

KEY FEATURES

  • ROG HFX Magnetic Switches

    The ROG HFX Magnetic Switches are engineered for a solid feel with lightning-fast, ultraprecise performance and a lifespan of 100 million keypresses.

  • Rapid Trigger Toggle

    A dedicated toggle switch on the top-right rear panel of the keyboard activates the Rapid Trigger feature for the fastest typing response and key repeat rate. By default, only WASD keys are enabled when this feature is activated.

  • 8000 HZ Polling Rate

    A high-speed USB microcontroller delivers an 8000 Hz polling rate that refreshes input up to 8X faster than most gaming keyboards, reducing delay from 1 millisecond to a mere 0.125 ms.

  • Five-Layer Dampening

    The Falchion Ace HFX ZywOo Edition uses five dampening layers - two PORON® and three silicone - to absorb keystroke vibrations and pinging noise, providing a superior cushioned typing experience.

  • Multi-Function Button and Touch Panel

    Intuitively control a variety of settings, including volume, media playback, keyboard lighting, and actuation point, as well as customizing commands.

  • Dual USB-C Port

    The Falchion Ace HFX ZywOo Edition features two USB-C ports on either side of the rear edge for a much neater setup, allowing users to connect up to two PCs simultaneously and quick-toggle switch between the two.
